# 3D model fixtures

Small files for checking the viewer's newer formats by hand (see the browser check in
docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-15-more-3d-formats.md). IGES and BREP fixtures are not here:
tests read them from node_modules/occt-import-js/test/testfiles/.

| File | Source | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| phong_cube.fbx | assimp test/models/FBX at `665ab04c73364c9b6351a28664399c758731a959` | BSD-3-Clause (assimp) |
| box.3mf | assimp test/models/3MF at `665ab04c73364c9b6351a28664399c758731a959`: minimal core 3MF box | BSD-3-Clause (assimp) |
| production_components.3mf | assimp test/models/3MF at `665ab04c73364c9b6351a28664399c758731a959`: synthetic Production Extension components file; assimpjs returned it empty | BSD-3-Clause (assimp) |
| box-mesh.3dm | generated by scripts/fixtures/make-3dm-fixtures.mjs | ours |
| sphere-no-render-mesh.3dm | same; a Brep with no render mesh, which must show the "no display meshes" message | ours |
